[Highlight start] **Benadryl (diphenhydramine) is not proven to treat or cure a hangover** [Highlight end] , and it is generally not recommended for this purpose.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_g_pfX1gRhj4V6SDMgrLuV6BEQlY5PGP07hvO0Q278Gel8qV74tFgTKl2oKGoQuHR3bXeTg8bit93fcS2AeqyIumRbh-6mM3BGBKOWxvwBh1i2rRce-iMlIADq4PC2xIRhCDMz3Abuk58ucJERw0HpSuoa9nuYv1b7hOMc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF15nw21QiamadXDXjUD5fxHI3Z_-CvnxAEnc9IzqYlyLe-fRR1mzDnDrjOq9ZuB5sITlf4wuiypLMzXmVCbPQNI1Z91AE-7GJpARLZiEol0X4-eEIGhC8NHo-jGAnXOw3HjV_IuRUAYl0wS7moJWNFaUiL6Xqy7lkacet7soLnjEmdojBLBTcCPz_i425riLeA654zcp6Z_Jb2b8)

While alcohol can trigger histamine release and inflammation, there is no strong clinical evidence showing that taking Benadryl alone relieves hangover symptoms. Combining diphenhydramine with alcohol also carries important safety risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF15nw21QiamadXDXjUD5fxHI3Z_-CvnxAEnc9IzqYlyLe-fRR1mzDnDrjOq9ZuB5sITlf4wuiypLMzXmVCbPQNI1Z91AE-7GJpARLZiEol0X4-eEIGhC8NHo-jGAnXOw3HjV_IuRUAYl0wS7moJWNFaUiL6Xqy7lkacet7soLnjEmdojBLBTcCPz_i425riLeA654zcp6Z_Jb2b8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXdXfb4Bje3mcECu92O2otYgPbxVUuxQPpEofK76sUP4Zd_2w3ja57370iy0_OEVi6P_nfslUhOOdtlI5hBjj-SWkUMQS7P3CepIAL6g_O1t1axENVy-i2TXkFIFJVl_r41pibV3SVeA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_g_pfX1gRhj4V6SDMgrLuV6BEQlY5PGP07hvO0Q278Gel8qV74tFgTKl2oKGoQuHR3bXeTg8bit93fcS2AeqyIumRbh-6mM3BGBKOWxvwBh1i2rRce-iMlIADq4PC2xIRhCDMz3Abuk58ucJERw0HpSuoa9nuYv1b7hOMc)

### Why Benadryl Is Not Ideal for Hangovers

- **Limited evidence:** One small pilot study tested a combination of an antihistamine (*fexofenadine* ) and an anti-inflammatory (*naproxen* ) before drinking, noting that neither drug alone showed a statistically significant benefit over a placebo. Benadryl itself has not been established as a hangover treatment.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXdXfb4Bje3mcECu92O2otYgPbxVUuxQPpEofK76sUP4Zd_2w3ja57370iy0_OEVi6P_nfslUhOOdtlI5hBjj-SWkUMQS7P3CepIAL6g_O1t1axENVy-i2TXkFIFJVl_r41pibV3SVeA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnwEBxCJF15nw21QiamadXDXjUD5fxHI3Z_-CvnxAEnc9IzqYlyLe-fRR1mzDnDrjOq9ZuB5sITlf4wuiypLMzXmVCbPQNI1Z91AE-7GJpARLZiEol0X4-eEIGhC8NHo-jGAnXOw3HjV_IuRUAYl0wS7moJWNFaUiL6Xqy7lkacet7soLnjEmdojBLBTcCPz_i425riLeA654zcp6Z_Jb2b8)
- **Added sedation and grogginess:** Benadryl causes drowsiness and can leave a "hangover" feeling of its own the next day. If alcohol is still in your system, combining them increases sedation and impairs coordination.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_g_pfX1gRhj4V6SDMgrLuV6BEQlY5PGP07hvO0Q278Gel8qV74tFgTKl2oKGoQuHR3bXeTg8bit93fcS2AeqyIumRbh-6mM3BGBKOWxvwBh1i2rRce-iMlIADq4PC2xIRhCDMz3Abuk58ucJERw0HpSuoa9nuYv1b7hOMc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX2RGHoPGlON-zdXJcKfqeqSSFGes3iHa8irEDS31wGWs5q0s3BvQW60TE-q7H-hseTTQC9ubzd10oMbhpWQFpkvvheWDWxRx1MBcX9q0mlroMQ5BMYty8M5CoL45a_AFCIg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXxOB1QbePrv75s1mOeD4MPW6tbC3VcViEhpfDRG_9MrF77c_es8ueRTXUqqkajfNBbU1DUhNGWU8610Gr8NBMFU2Xwuuz8M4wj1E1sotoGv7pxjoSM1dK1Tya8p1rmNY2kY4ZQr_hrW1CEtA0sZfRUMcsoFRqMWUqTw)
- **Doesn't fix core causes:** Hangovers stem from dehydration, disrupted sleep, stomach irritation, low blood sugar, and inflammatory responses—none of which Benadryl directly corrects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXqbwdK013QDVMMf9f6Zd_g3mdOPqF0UCpx4VO7PQB47SIK9yx0ecLwSrg6fevDQYojVq1div1EyAsZtx6C_hQ__oFHqceI3_ub9BkEk7mhxAtedvaVE7FrYC-6uCNdejJC8mIMZLe4dau2kyekcGh)

### Safer Ways to Manage Hangover Symptoms

- **Rehydrate and eat:** Sip water or electrolyte fluids and eat bland carbohydrates to help blood sugar and stomach comfort.
- **Check medication risks:** Be cautious with pain relievers. NSAIDs (like ibuprofen or naproxen) can irritate an already sensitive stomach, and acetaminophen (Tylenol) increases the risk of liver strain when alcohol is involved.
- **Give it time:** Rest and time are the most reliable ways for your body to recover.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXGHBQOPiVvnp9gEWCTRrspvyCsMuoH4eL_B2vgjBmEXfRIfEP8vSpS-QW21MK0n2Q72J_YKgMS7kYkDMYfGJdXZ759OU6g58W5X3hdyof6K1IN-CCqicAxoY1VTpg0Iyw18JuE4tRiXI0oclehSc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXqbwdK013QDVMMf9f6Zd_g3mdOPqF0UCpx4VO7PQB47SIK9yx0ecLwSrg6fevDQYojVq1div1EyAsZtx6C_hQ__oFHqceI3_ub9BkEk7mhxAtedvaVE7FrYC-6uCNdejJC8mIMZLe4dau2kyekcGh)

For more details on safe recovery and risks, see [Poison Control](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_g_pfX1gRhj4V6SDMgrLuV6BEQlY5PGP07hvO0Q278Gel8qV74tFgTKl2oKGoQuHR3bXeTg8bit93fcS2AeqyIumRbh-6mM3BGBKOWxvwBh1i2rRce-iMlIADq4PC2xIRhCDMz3Abuk58ucJERw0HpSuoa9nuYv1b7hOMc) and [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXqbwdK013QDVMMf9f6Zd_g3mdOPqF0UCpx4VO7PQB47SIK9yx0ecLwSrg6fevDQYojVq1div1EyAsZtx6C_hQ__oFHqceI3_ub9BkEk7mhxAtedvaVE7FrYC-6uCNdejJC8mIMZLe4dau2kyekcGh) . (Online discussions also reflect mixed opinions on antihistamines for hangovers, with some users on [Quora](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXq49xNyIBc7ZH_S4VQqfpl-okbdx75edJXdWpwMDHl0jZvHVtrV1cw8KfCxqJJS1MTHyrWSidRfVtHdzBnrWx7Ul4CxEJdbOVuZyEwOLrpOGj_7mhF2r1dkv3vmNRcfmZ2mMoW4la6tWHMW0om5TuklQ) claiming symptom relief while others warn it does not address dehydration and can worsen grogginess.)[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1_g_pfX1gRhj4V6SDMgrLuV6BEQlY5PGP07hvO0Q278Gel8qV74tFgTKl2oKGoQuHR3bXeTg8bit93fcS2AeqyIumRbh-6mM3BGBKOWxvwBh1i2rRce-iMlIADq4PC2xIRhCDMz3Abuk58ucJERw0HpSuoa9nuYv1b7hOMc)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXqbwdK013QDVMMf9f6Zd_g3mdOPqF0UCpx4VO7PQB47SIK9yx0ecLwSrg6fevDQYojVq1div1EyAsZtx6C_hQ__oFHqceI3_ub9BkEk7mhxAtedvaVE7FrYC-6uCNdejJC8mIMZLe4dau2kyekcGh)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXq49xNyIBc7ZH_S4VQqfpl-okbdx75edJXdWpwMDHl0jZvHVtrV1cw8KfCxqJJS1MTHyrWSidRfVtHdzBnrWx7Ul4CxEJdbOVuZyEwOLrpOGj_7mhF2r1dkv3vmNRcfmZ2mMoW4la6tWHMW0om5TuklQ)If you'd like more tailored information, share:
